title: Trace tag scanning
statement: The system shall scan component sources for reqforge trace tags and store a per-component index with file, line, symbol and file hashes.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: implements/verifies tags and framework markers are extracted and attached to the nearest symbol
The index is written and vendor directories are skipped
A requirements repo inside the component is never scanned
Explicit tag mode, reqforge:off/on regions and reqforge:ignore-file suppress data mentions
